model_output.rationale: Both lines carry CO-29 (timely filing expired). The 837P is dated October 15, 2025 — nine months after the January 19, 2025 DOS — plainly outside any commercial filing window. However, the 277CA dated January 27, 2025 shows STC*A2 acceptance of TRC75364521, the same transaction reference in the 837P BHT, proving the original claim was submitted and accepted 8 days post-DOS. Commercial CI payer; N211 does not bar a commercial appeal.

root_cause.explanation: CO-29 on both lines. The 837P visible is dated October 15, 2025 (9 months post-DOS). The same TRC (TRC75364521) was accepted per 277CA on January 27, 2025 — 8 days post-DOS — proving timely original filing.

next_action.detail: Appeal CO-29 denial attaching the January 27, 2025 277CA (STC*A2, TRN TRC75364521) as clearinghouse acceptance proof of timely original filing. CI commercial payer; N211 does not bar a commercial appeal. Dispute payer's receipt date against the 277CA date.

evidence.fact: Both service lines CAS*CO*29 — $91.91 and $46.71 fully denied timely filing expired; $0 paid; CLP07=2530598850660 confirms adjudicated claim.
837P ISA date October 15, 2025; DOS January 19, 2025 — approximately 9 months elapsed.
STC*A2:20 dated January 27, 2025, referencing TRC75364521 — clearinghouse acceptance of original submission 8 days after DOS, inside any plausible commercial filing window.
Filing indicator CI (commercial); MOA N211 is a Medicare-paired remark and does not prohibit appeal on a commercial claim.

citations.rule: Proof of accepted submission inside the window → appeal with the clearinghouse acceptance report (strongest proof)
CARC 29: proof accepted inside window → appeal; CO = provider liability, not billable to patient
CO = contractual obligation; never bill patient; N211 paired with CO-29 only on Medicare FFS
